pages.title: Innate Immunity
pages.text: $(thing)Innate Immunity$()$(br2)The body's first answer, the same for every invader: cells that engulf what does not belong, and inflammation that walls it off. Unlocks Antibodies.

$(thing)Insight$(): 110$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Microbiology, Respiration.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Bacterial Culture, 1 Living Cell.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A phagocyte clears invaders at a rate proportional to how many are left: dN/dt = -cN. Write how many remain, M, after time t, from a start of N.
